answer.summary: A new, focused research question is proposed to investigate explicit memory decay mechanisms in tokenized agents under controlled perturbation regimes.
answer.content: Investigate whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 reports any explicitly defined memory decay rates or thresholds under known perturbations, and if so, determine the minimum time interval between inputs required to observe a measurable degradation in state coherence as an indicator of memory decay in a tokenized agent. This query targets a distinct aspect of memory dynamics not previously explored in prior handoffs.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to extract and verify explicitly reported memory decay rates or thresholds in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under known perturbations; if any exist, define the minimum time interval between inputs required to observe a measurable degradation in state coherence as an indicator of memory decay in a tokenized agent
answer.lesson: Memory decay mechanisms must be explicitly modeled and observed under perturbation to establish empirical validity beyond implicit or assumed dynamics.
